features.feature: Templates → Skills lists each skill: name, Built in / Customized / Yours, ⚠ problem count, an on/off switch, its description
A skill shows its SKILL.md as written, what its folder holds, "in Claude as /my-skills:<id>", and what to fix before Claude can use it
Customize copies a built-in skill to the user's folder; Reset takes the copy away; Delete moves one of the user's to the trash
A skill off or with problems is left out of Claude and out of the Claude dialog's list
New skill makes its folder with a SKILL.md and opens it; Open in VS Code and Show in Finder open the folder; a skill changed since the panel's session started shows "Restart to update"
